podcast.title: Band Dissolution and Output
podcast.body: By the time Staggered Crossing broke up in 2007, they had released four full-length albums and one EP. "And by the time they broke up in 2007, they'd released four albums in 1 EP."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Extensive Touring
podcast.body: After the release of their debut album in 2001, Staggered Crossing embarked on tours with notable acts such as Nickelback, The Guess Who, Midnight Oil, Spirit of the West, Blue Rodeo, and Big Sugar, among others. "From there they toured with Nickelback, the Guess Who, Midnight Oil, Spirited the West, Blurodio, Big Sugar and others."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Toronto Origins and Record Deal
podcast.body: Staggered Crossing, also known as Stag X, was a band from Toronto that formed in 1996. They secured a record deal with Warner Music in 1997. "This was a Toronto band. They came together in 1996. It's got a deal with Warner Music in 1997."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
